added_models.model: Ex vivo cytotoxicity against primary lymph-node B-NHL tumour cells (epcoritamab)

efficacy.note: Epcoritamab lysed primary DLBCL tumour cells from lymph-node biopsies (median 65%), including from patients relapsed or refractory to anti-CD20 therapy.
efficacy.short: Kills primary DLBCL cells ex vivo
efficacy.quote: In the presence of T-cells from a healthy donor, epcoritamab demonstrated potent activity against primary tumor cells, irrespective of prior treatments, including CD20 mAbs.
efficacy.confidence_note: Quote verbatim in the abstract (PMID 33602901); full text read on PMC7892878.
efficacy.judgement: Opening entry at publication; a system distinct from the draft's humanized-mouse xenografts (patients' own tumour cells, healthy-donor or autologous T cells, no animal). retrodiction flag is carried on the scored entry only.

efficacy.note: The authors set the ex vivo killing beside the ongoing first-in-human trial's early responses in R/R DLBCL, which were already public when the work was published.
efficacy.short: Ex vivo killing matches known responses
efficacy.quote: These data support the single-agent activity of epcoritamab demonstrated in the ongoing first in human trial
efficacy.reason: Run after trial responses were known
efficacy.confidence_note: Full text (PMC7892878) cites the phase I/II trial's preliminary DLBCL/FL efficacy (ref 14, NCT03625037) as already reported; not found in BLA 761324 review.
efficacy.judgement: Retrodiction: the paper cites the trial's encouraging DLBCL responses, so the clinic knew the answer first; it reproduced activity, hence retro, not same. comparison_stated true because the paper itself sets model and trial side by side.
efficacy.magnitude_basis: ex vivo lysis of primary DLBCL cells vs objective responses in R/R DLBCL

considered_not_added: Mosunetuzumab (CD20-TDB) cynomolgus B-cell depletion and humanized/xenograft tumour killing (Sun 2015, doi:10.1126/scitranslmed.aaa4802) vs Budde 2022: same systems as the draft's cyno and humanized-mouse tracks; patient results (B-cell depletion, aNHL ORR 34.9%) agree in direction, so no new track and no status change. Adjudicator may append them as strengthening entries on those tracks.

Mosunetuzumab cynomolgus toxicology (BLA 761263: CRS-like signs, infections in 26-week study) vs patient CRS/infections: same system as the draft's cyno safety track; agrees in direction, no new track.

Imvotamab (IgM CD20xCD3) cyno and humanized-mouse xenograft data (Cancer Res 2022 suppl abstract 4179) vs NCT04082936: same systems as existing tracks; ASH 2021 abstract reported DLBCL ORR ~31% (activity, same direction). Development halted for business/portfolio reasons; no efficacy contradiction found. Not verified beyond press/abstract level.

Ex vivo patient-level biomarkers from van der Horst 2021 (HVEM inverse association, lymph-node effector:target ratio): no patient trial found comparing these with clinical response; not added as a patient-level track.

CD20 antigen-density prediction (cell-line killing vs CD20 level) vs patient CD20 expression and response: odronextamab data (outside the member list) show CR with low CD20; no member-drug comparison found in the searches run.
MT-3724 xenograft/nonclinical models: no published preclinical efficacy paper found (Europe PMC); draft already carries its unpublished toxicology track.
Zuberitamab (HS006) preclinical ADCC/CDC and xenograft vs rituximab: no published preclinical paper found; phase 3 Hi-CHOP vs R-CHOP (doi:10.1136/jitc-2024-008895) has no model side to pair.
Mosunetuzumab human PBMC EC20 assay and QSP CRS model: already tracked in the draft.

gaps.lead: Mosunetuzumab (CD20-TDB) cynomolgus + xenograft track: Sun 2015 vs Budde 2022 (engagement and efficacy)
gaps.detail: cell engagement, index 1 (cyno-epcoritamab opening untested entry): field year, current 2020 (Engelberts 2020; track model_first_use_year 2017), source supports 2015 with src https://doi.org/10.1126/scitranslmed.aaa4802 (Sun 2015, PMID 25972002, first published 2015-05-01) and model_first_use_year 2015 for the cynomolgus system: 'In cynomolgus monkeys, CD20-TDB potently depletes B cells in peripheral blood and lymphoid tissues at a single dose of 1 mg/kg' (mosunetuzumab, a class member, product_in_model true). No status changes: Budde 2022 patient B-cell depletion agrees in direction, and the track is already same from 2021 (Hutchings 2021). No verdict in check.json proposes this; it bears on check rule_question 3.

gaps.lead: Mosunetuzumab cynomolgus toxicology (BLA 761263: CRS-like signs, infections) vs patient CRS and infections
gaps.detail: cyno-epcoritamab, safety entry 2 (same, 2021, Hutchings 2021): monkey first-dose cytokine release vs patient CRS; the mosunetuzumab cyno data (public only in the 2022 BLA review) agree in direction and change no status or date.

gaps.lead: Imvotamab (IgM CD20xCD3) preclinical (Cancer Res 2022 suppl 4179) vs NCT04082936
gaps.detail: Same systems as existing tracks; NCT04082936 terminated for strategic pipeline prioritization with no posted results and no peer-reviewed patient paper (only ASH 2021 abstract, ORR ~31% in DLBCL, same direction): rule 2/5, no admissible comparison and no failure to score (unsettled).

gaps.detail: check.json efficacy index 3 (corrected, adjudicated same): src to the NCT04628494 tier 3 registry record posted 2026-11-03, trial_unreported false, outcome_tested negative on OS. The EHA 2026 PFS improvement changes no status; it belongs in that entry's note/patient_trials.
